design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — installation_contract_servicing, task 1 (written section by section and persisted as designed).

STEP 0 — draw and scope. draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 4, 4, 6]}. Occupied by task 0: install_ext_reschedule_fee, install_ext_final_payment, post_reschedule_fee_05a0220d, pay_final_balance_37ea441b. Claimed here (all unoccupied): install_ext_trip_charge (5 factors), install_ext_change_order_fee (4), install_ext_permit_handling_fee (6), install_ext_progress_payment (4, root, customer's own write); tools post_trip_charge_9239fb96, post_change_order_fee_b62b1022, post_permit_handling_fee_ee01a5f4, pay_progress_payment_cb1125dd. M = 2, so no headroom is owed after this task; together the two tasks cover all six extended policies.
Design thesis: surface goal 'pay the payment due now that work has started, with my bank card' -> the start-of-work payment rule carries three prerequisite sentences (trip charge line for every customer-side failed visit; administration fee line for every signed price-raising change order; permit handling fee line for an issued pass-through permit) -> the records show a 2026-09-28 customer no-show with no trip charge, CO-1 with no administration fee, an issued permit with no handling fee -> three agent fee writes, each a multi-factor computation -> the start-of-work payment (4 factors) on the world with the three lines -> the customer authorises his own bank card charge. Shape: fan-out, three value_input edges (>= max(3-1,1) = 2).

WHY A GOOD TEST. The customer names only the payment. Each fee is owed by the records (state_due) and is discoverable only from a prerequisite sentence plus the records; each fee then needs its own document set (visit-day method, occurrence, advance call, crew size, staged materials; change size, signing speed, sequence, permit amendment; permit size, issue time, signing lead, permit hold, re-inspection, permit payment); the root needs the Project Loan in another product. An agent with only computation documents gets 179.00 / 50.00 / 95.00 and a start-of-work payment of 7,040.03 on the gold world.

FACTOR CARD (tier taken / evidence / baseline figure from the Step 5 sensitivity run):
Trip charge (expected 204.30, baseline_result 179.00): visit_day method — no-show on the original date 2026-09-28 -> 179.00 + 200.00 = 379.00 (baseline 96.49); occurrence — exactly one customer-side failed visit -> 0.5 (408.61); advance_call — declined reschedule registered 2026-09-28 07:10, same day -> 0.75 (272.41); crew_size — billed 18,400.00 >= 15,000 -> 1.25 (163.44); staged_materials — received 2026-09-08, 20 days before -> 1.15 (177.66). Near-miss: the declined request is not a carried-out reschedule (customer_reschedule_count 0), so no reschedule fee is owed.
Change order fee (expected 46.08, baseline_result 50.00): change_size method — 1,600.00 > 1,500.00 -> 50.00 + 10.00 = 60.00 (38.40); signing_speed — same-day signing -> 0.8 (57.60); change_sequence — first change order -> 0.8 (57.60); permit_amendment — permit line 2026-09-04 before CO-1 2026-10-02 -> 1.2 (38.40). Revision: permit_amendment_multiple was first 1.25; check_compute reported the history floor not load-bearing (zeroing COUNTs gave 48.00 = 60 x 0.8 x 1.25 x 0.8 by coincidence); changed to 1.2 -> 46.08, propagated to the gold call, the computation and the root (6,852.99 -> 6,851.07); re-run COMPUTE OK.
Permit handling fee (expected 197.65, baseline_result 95.00): permit_size method — 520.00 >= 500 -> 95.00 + 26.00 = 121.00 (155.18); issue_time — 32 days > 30 -> 1.2 (164.71); signing_lead — 7 days, inclusive boundary of the quick tier -> 0.9 (219.62; near-miss: an 8-day lead would take 1); permit_hold — 24 days > 21 -> 1.1 (179.69); reinspection (multi-source) — customer no-show AND no installer miss -> 1.25 (158.12); permit_payment (multi-source) — unpaid AND 32 days > 30 -> 1.1 (179.69).
Start-of-work payment (expected 6,851.07, baseline_result 7,040.03): project_loan_financing (parameter, cross-difficulty card, multi-source) — active Project Loan 84 8325354b..., draw end 2027-02-01 after today AND approved 15,000.00 below 18,400.00 -> 0.75 (8,278.75); signing_wait — 64 days > 60 -> 0.95 (7,076.49); start_day_timing — paid the day work started -> -1 percent of 4,326.30 = -43.26 (6,894.33); change_order_collection method — CO-1 billed 2026-10-02 before the 2026-10-06 start -> 1,600.00 in full (5,251.07).

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Fee writes (install_fee_charged): governing install_agg_same_address, install_cancellation_fees, install_scheduling, install_visits_and_delays, install_change_orders, install_permits_and_haul_away; none has an eligibility gate on install_fee_charged -> policy_scope each, evidence the contract status and the triggering row. overwrites: install_visits_and_delays' trip charge sentence, install_change_orders' 'incurs change_order_admin_fee_usd' clause, install_permits_and_haul_away's handling fee clause, each replaced by the extended amount sentence. Payment write: install_payments.payable_status, status in_progress allowed; overwrite of 'A progress payment of progress_payment_pct percent of the contract price is due on the day work starts'. No time gate on any write. Tender bank_card: no card/trade trigger.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Contract b26c80be... (IC-1187-512907). Trip charge keyed to visit line 996bb4ef... (the only customer-side failed visit). Administration fee keyed to request 0c6eed73... (CO-1's request). Handling fee on the contract (one permit). The start-of-work payment reads all contract lines; the deposit ec6203b6... is not a fee payment and does not cover fees; fee payments are 0.00.

SEED. Customer, Project Loan account (no draws yet, balance 0.00 — consistent with the card charter's draw period of 6 months from 2026-08-01), contract, 7 lines, 2 requests. Removing the no-show visit removes the trip charge prerequisite and changes reinspection; removing the permit line removes the handling fee prerequisite and changes permit_amendment; removing the loan changes the financing share. Automatic clauses: no delay credit (start 8 days after the original date, below 14, and a customer no-show intervened); no customer reschedule; one no-show is below the 2-visit cancellation count; no no-show credit (customer-side). balance_due 14,448.00 equals the ledger.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root install_ext_progress_payment; edges (all value_input, gate fee_total, form state):
- -> install_ext_trip_charge: 'The start-of-work payment is not worked out until every installation visit on the contract at which the customer was absent or the site was not ready carries its trip charge line.' (negated direction, 'not ... until').
- -> install_ext_change_order_fee: 'The start-of-work payment is fixed only after every signed change order that raises the contract price carries its administration fee line.' (affirmative, 'only after').
- -> install_ext_permit_handling_fee: 'Before the start-of-work payment is fixed, an issued permit whose fee is passed through at cost must carry its permit handling fee line on the contract.' (affirmative, 'Before ... must').
Four-point test for each: ordering connective present; waits on a record-visible line kind; no tool, id or code token; scope matches the condition. Exactly one write of the difficulty brings each state about (the only writers of fee_type trip_charge, change_order_admin_fee and permit_handling_fee are these three policies' tools). Derivation: each sentence + install_charges (failed visit / CO-1 / permit line present, matching fee line absent) + the depended-on rule ('posts as one ... line ...') -> that fee write. Unresolved at frozen_time: proved by the visit, change order and permit rows with no matching fee line. Topological order: trip charge (7), administration fee (9), handling fee (11), payment (13); the three commute (verified: order 11, 9, 7 gives 6,851.07). Deletion sensitivity: skip 7 -> 6,646.77; skip 9 -> 6,804.99; skip 11 -> 6,653.42. user_scenario mentions none of them; no tool validates any.

PERSONA. Leopold Aranha-Whitcombe, gruff retired teacher; volunteers the goal only; phone/ZIP/SSN last four/DOB, contract number/address, the project loan only when asked; passive reaction: grumbles and agrees when told charges go on first; runs the payment for exactly the amount given; ends after confirmation. No figure of his own, no further asks.

STANDARD SOLUTION (14 actions): find_customers(phone) -> verify(ZIP, SSN last four) -> find_install_contracts -> find_install_charges -> find_install_requests -> find_card_accounts -> unlock/call post_trip_charge_9239fb96(contract, visit 996bb4ef..., 204.30) -> unlock/call post_change_order_fee_b62b1022(contract, request 0c6eed73..., 46.08) -> unlock/call post_permit_handling_fee_ee01a5f4(contract, 197.65) -> unlock_user/call_user pay_progress_payment_cb1125dd(contract, 6851.07).

VERIFICATION RUN (handling-time recompute, executed): trip charge bindings visit_day_amount=379.0, occurrence_share=0.5, advance_call_share=0.75, crew_size_share=1.25, staging_days=20, result=204.3; admin fee scaled_admin_amount=60.0, signing_gap_days=0, change_order_count=1, permit_before_change=28, result=46.08; handling fee permit_size_amount=121.0, issue_time_days=32, signing_lead_days=7, permit_hold_days=24, reinspection_share=1.25, permit_payment_share=1.1, result=197.65; payment fee_total=968.03, financing_share=0.75, wait_days=64, progress_share=4326.3, timing_adjustment=-43.26, change_order_collection=1600.0, result=6851.07. Gates: check_task_tools OK, check_extended --task 1 OK, replay_tasks --task 1 OK, check_solvability --task 1 OK, check_compute --task 1 OK, check_grounding --task 1 OK, check_cross_fire --task 1 OK.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. From the published rules and the find_* returns alone: the contract is in progress (payable); the start-of-work payment waits on three fee lines that are missing; the three amounts are 204.30, 46.08 and 197.65; the payment is 4,326.30 - 43.26 + 1,600.00 + 968.03 = 6,851.07. Agrees with gold.

DIFFICULTY-LEVEL CLOSING. Six extended policies, each claimed by exactly one task (task 0: reschedule fee, final payment; task 1: trip charge, administration fee, handling fee, progress payment); six tools, disjoint; every task has a customer-owned write, a multi-source and a cross-difficulty factor (task 0: card and special; task 1: card).
user_scenario: You are Leopold Aranha-Whitcombe, a retired high-school chemistry teacher in Columbus, Ohio, a little gruff but fair, calling Ridgeline Customer Care late in the morning. The Ridgeline roofing crew started tearing off your old roof this morning, and the foreman told you the next payment on the job is due now that work has started. You want to pay that payment right now, yourself, with your own bank card, while you have the card in hand. You open with something like: "The roofing crew started on my house this morning and I want to pay the payment that's due now that work has started, with my bank card." You do not know the amount and have no figure in mind; you expect Ridgeline to tell you the correct amount and you will pay exactly what you are told. To find your account you give your phone number, 6145550388. To confirm who you are you give your billing ZIP code, 43221, and the last four of your Social Security number, 6012; if one more detail is needed, your date of birth is 1968-06-21. Only if asked for the contract you read the number off your paperwork, IC-1187-512907, and the address is 2290 Brandon Road, Columbus, OH 43221. Only if the agent asks about financing or other Ridgeline accounts, you say you set up a Ridgeline project loan this summer and have not drawn on it yet. If the agent explains that some charges have to be put on the contract before the payment can be worked out, you grumble that nobody mentioned them, then say fine, put them on, and you do not argue the amounts. When the agent tells you the amount and hands the payment to you, you complete it yourself for exactly that amount, and you can read the confirmation back if asked. If asked which card, it is your own bank debit card. You do not ask for anything else. Once the payment is confirmed you say thanks and hang up.
